note: What a run downloads and what its preparation writes, as measured on real runs; read by gpuwm/download_budget.py. A download row prices each object a fetch requests for one source and byte transport: `objects` is bytes per object of each role, `objects_per_point` is bytes per object per grid point of the requested area for a transport that crops, and `transfer_per_object` is what crosses the network when that differs from what is left on disk. A row with `same_as` is priced as another transport of the same source and says why. `legacy_sources` names how the four transports that predate the route table count their objects, the transport each takes when no mode is named, as `archive_mode` the transport it switches to when no mode is named and only the archive still holds the cycle, and for a transport that selects records, how it counts them; a row whose crop size follows the records it selects says how many its measurement selected (`measured_records`) and is priced per record of the request; a table route's objects are the route's own resolved object list. A preparation row prices what one chain's preparation writes per grid cell: per cell and forcing time on the outer grid, per cell once on the outer grid, per boundary cell and forcing time, and per cell of a nest.

compose_scratch.note: The decoded frame stream a preparation that composes through the mapped engine stages in its scratch folder while it runs (gpuwm_mapped_engine frames.f64): per source, every field its mapping publishes on the source's own grid, each vertical field once per level of the mapping's ladder and each soil field once per layer the source publishes, as 8-byte values, for every valid time the preparation composes. `grid_points` is the source grid (a source remapped from an unstructured mesh names its `normalization` document instead, whose window around the target is the grid), `layers_per_valid_time` the fields times their levels, `soil_layers` how many of those are soil layers (the source's own soil column, which a mapping does not state), `windowed_layers` how many of those layers the atmospheric window crops to the target's footprint (none for a global source, whose representation stays whole), and `bytes_per_value` the stream's value size. It scales with the SOURCE grid, not the target, so it is priced here and not per target cell. `chains` names the chains whose preparation composes this way.
